text: Stop a Cluiston on Lake Okeechobee, Florida's biggest lake surrounded by sugarcane.
Cluiston calls itself America's sweetest town.
Fans matched it to the game's Ambrosia, its slogan, keeping Leonita sweet.
The real sugar company becomes Allied Crystal.
Rockstar copied the town and the sales pitch.
Now turn south, all the way south, to the end of the road.
Stop 9. The Florida Keys. A chain of islands stitched together by bridges like
the Seven Mile Bridge. In the game, the Leonita Keys. Same island chain, same long
bridge. In the real Keys, a roadside village has a giant lobster, nine meters
tall. Her name is Betsy. In the game, Betsy is gone. In her place, a giant whale.
Florida has islands, beaches, swamps, and sugar. What it does not have is mountains.
Stop 10. Mount Calaga. Florida's highest natural point is Britain Hill, just 105
meters. That's the lowest top point of any U.S. state. Plenty of Miami
skyscrapers are taller than Florida's tallest hill. But GTA 6's Florida has a
whole mountain national park. Fans trace its canyons to Providence Canyon in
neighboring Georgia. So the copy has something the original doesn't. And
that's when the original started copying the copy.
